author: Cleo Abram
description:
How many Earths do you think would fit inside Neptune? Saturn? Our Sun?

Here are the answers! Most people don’t understand how mind-blowingly HUGE other planets in our solar system actually are. And what’s REALLY wild is there are an estimated 100 billion planets in our galaxy. 

If you like optimistic science and tech stories, subscribe!

#shorts #space #science #animation #planets
title: How Big Other Planets Really Are
